payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Can the small square DVD case near the center of the source image be identified as the same object in the edited image, and what is its color there?
node.criteria: Complete only if the same source DVD is visibly identifiable in the edited image and is white. Partial if that same DVD is identifiable and visibly changed from black toward white but is not white. Absent if the same DVD is identifiable and remains black with no requested color change. Unknown if the DVD cannot be reliably matched across images or its color/change cannot be established; do not count other white discs as the target.
node.binding: Target: the small square DVD case near the center of the source image, with a rectangular outline and visible cover artwork. Compare that same object in the edited image; do not bind to either newly visible circular disc unless visual evidence establishes it is the same source object.

outcome.description: Change the DVD from black to white.
